name: 1 Apr 1947

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1308 (Alteration of boundary of Urban County District of Portadown (confirmation of Armagh County Council order of 30 Apr 1946))
references.note: 19 Jul 1946, page 174. Made 11 Jul 1946. In force: 1 Apr 1947. Confirms the county council order extending Portadown UD (boundary from the River Bann via Seagoe Upper/Killycomain townlands).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1335 (Enniskillen Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1946 (confirmation))
references.note: 24 Jan 1947, page 17. Made 16 Jan 1947. In force: 1 Apr 1947. Confirms with modifications Fermanagh County Council's order of 19 Jul 1946 altering Enniskillen UD.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1336 (Enniskillen Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1946 (confirmation; reprint))
references.note: 31 Jan 1947, page 28. Made 16 Jan 1947. In force: 1 Apr 1947. Same confirmation as seq 45, printed again a week later.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1339 (Cookstown Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1947 (confirmation with modifications))
references.note: 21 Feb 1947, page 49. Made 13 Feb 1947. In force: 1 Apr 1947. Confirms with modifications Tyrone County Council's order on the UDC's 1939 proposal altering Cookstown UD.

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1951: Preliminary Report
references.note: Changes in administrative areas since 1937, items (9)-(10), (17)-(18), (20) and (22) (1 Apr 1947).

references.label: Urban Districts Boundaries (Procedure) Order (Northern Ireland) 1936 (S.R. & O. 1936 No. 170)
references.note: Made 9 Dec 1936 by the Ministry of Home Affairs under section 24 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934: the local inquiry and public notices required before a county council could make an order altering or defining the boundary of an urban county district. The Enniskillen and Cookstown orders confirmed early in 1947 recite compliance with it (Belfast Gazette, issues 1335, 1336 and 1339).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1308 (Portadown Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1946)
references.note: 19 Jul 1946, page 175. Made 30 Apr 1946. In force: 1 Apr 1947. District boundary altered: Portadown Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1946; places named: Portadown Urban District; by Ministry of Health and Local Government; made 30 April 1946; in force 1 April 1947.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1313 (Lurgan Rural District (boundary alteration))
references.note: 23 Aug 1946, page 207. In force: 1 Apr 1947. District boundary altered: Rural District of Lurgan; places named: Lurgan Rural District, Portadown Urban District, Derry, Lurgan Rural, County Armagh; by Ministry of Health and Local Government; in force 1 April 1947; under Local Government Act (Northern Ireland), 1934.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1335 (Enniskillen Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1946)
references.note: 21 Jan 1947, page 18. Made 19 Jul 1946. In force: 1 Apr 1947. District boundary altered: Enniskillen Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1946; places named: Enniskillen Urban District, County Fermanagh; by Ministry of Health and Local Government; made 19 July 1946; in force 1 April 1947; under Local Government Act (Northern Ireland), 1934.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1354 (Cookstown Rural District (boundary alteration))
references.note: 30 May 1947, page 137. Made 1 Apr 1947. District boundary altered: Rural District of Cookstown; places named: Cookstown Rural District, Cookstown Urban District, County Tyrone; by Ministry of Health and Local Government; made 1 April 1947; under Local Government Act (Northern Ireland), 1934.

notes: 1 Apr 1947 reuses the converted geometry from 11 Jun 1946.

approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Armagh urban district boundary are traced from the map deposited with the 1946 Order (about 20 m); parts of the Lurgan boundary are traced from the 1937 extension plan (about 25 m). They are drawn dotted on the map.
